description: Send an outreach email to a recruiter or referrer about a job. The email will be sent from your configured email. Pass applicationId for a saved application, or jobId for a job from search_jobs / match_jobs: with jobId the job is first added to your applications (reusing your existing application for that job if there is one), then the email is sent.

applicationId.description: The job application ID. Pass this or jobId.

contactId.description: The contact ID (from get_job_recruiters / get_job_referrers for a jobId, or get_application_recruiters / get_application_referrers for an applicationId)

jobHuntId.description: With jobId only: the job hunt to save the job under. Defaults to your most recently updated active job hunt.

jobId.description: A job ID (from search_jobs, match_jobs or get_job) for a job you have not saved yet. Pass this or applicationId.

slot.description: The slot returned by the contact tools; pass it through so the outreach is recorded correctly

name: send_outreach
